# eGrowth

> Tech and marketing agency in Morocco. We provide Moroccan brands and
> e-commerce sellers with agency ad accounts on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Google
> and LinkedIn, run the campaigns on them, build the stores and apps the ads
> point at, and produce the UGC videos that go in them.

The site is published in French (default, at the root), English (/en/) and
Arabic (/ar/). Each page exists in all three languages with reciprocal
hreflang.

## What we are precise about

- An ad account cannot be bought or sold. Platform terms restrict transferring
  accounts. What an agency can legitimately provide is managed access to spend
  through its own agency structure, under a written service agreement. Anyone
  advertising "unlimited budget" or "zero suspensions" is describing something
  no agency controls.
- The client keeps the Business Manager, the Page, the pixel, the datasets, the
  audiences and the catalogue. eGrowth holds the ad account, the billing
  relationship, the written spend cap and the policy liability.
- VAT: TikTok Ads began charging Moroccan advertisers 20% VAT on 1 August 2026,
  and Meta on 1 October 2026. It applies where Morocco is the account's sale
  country and no tax identification number is on file. eGrowth's accounts carry
  a valid TIN and invoice in dirhams. We are not tax advisers.
- Moroccan market benchmarks, measured October 2026: roughly 25–60 MAD CPM and
  1.0–3.5 MAD CPC. A workable e-commerce test budget is 4,000–8,000 MAD a month
  of media, on top of the management fee.
